### Figure 4

#### The targets we selected for the screen:

```{r}
targets_dir <- find_most_recent_folder("Figure3")
targets_dir
metabolic_targets <- read_csv(here(
  targets_dir,
  "metabolic_targets.csv"
))

table(metabolic_targets$selection_siRNA)

metabolic_targets <- filter(metabolic_targets, selection_siRNA == "selected")
dim(metabolic_targets)
head(metabolic_targets)

table(metabolic_targets$selection_siRNA)

target_selection <- c(
  c("mock", "KP control"),
  c("ITGB1", "bosutinib"),
  "flavopiridol",
  metabolic_targets$gene_symbol
)
length(target_selection)
```

#### The siRNA results - proliferation:

```{r}
proliferation <- read_csv(here(data_dir, "proliferation_siRNA_screen.csv"))
dim(proliferation)
head(proliferation)

proliferation <- proliferation |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    mean_prol = mean(c(rep1, rep2, rep3)),
    sd_prol = sd(c(rep1, rep2, rep3)),
    SEM_prol = sd_prol / sqrt(3)
  )

# Sort to have controls on the left
proliferation <- proliferation |>
  mutate(is_control = case_when(
    target %in% c("mock", "KP control") ~ "siRNA control",
    target %in% c("ITGB1", "bosutinib") ~ "migration inhibitor positive control",
    target == "flavopiridol" ~ "proliferation inhibitor positive control",
    TRUE ~ "candidate"
  )) |>
  mutate(is_control = factor(
    is_control,
    levels = c(
      "siRNA control", "migration inhibitor positive control",
      "proliferation inhibitor positive control", "candidate"
    )
  )) |>
  arrange(is_control, mean_prol)

table(proliferation$is_control)
# Print all targets with at least a 20% change in proliferation
proliferation |>
  filter(mean_prol > 1.2)

proliferation |>
  filter(mean_prol < 0.8)

proliferation |>
  filter(mean_prol < 0.5)
```

### Calculate which genes changed significantly

Because of the correction compared to the mock, the question is for each target whether its value is significantly different from 1.

```{r}
check_difference_from_mock <- function(df, verbose = FALSE) {
  mock_value <- df |>
    filter(target == "mock") |>
    summarize(mean(rep1, rep2, rep3)) |>
    pull()

  df <- df |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      p.value = ifelse(target == "mock", 1,
        t.test(x = c(rep1, rep2, rep3), mu = mock_value)$p.value
      )
    )
  # correct for multiple testing
  df$padj <- p.adjust(df$p.value, method = "BH")

  df <- df |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      significant_hit = ifelse(is_control == "candidate",
        ifelse(padj < 0.1, "FDR < 0.1", "not significant"), as.character(is_control)
      )
    )

  if (verbose) {
    print(str_glue("Mock value is {mock_value}"))
    print(str_glue("Nr of significant differences (p.value) with p < 0.05 is {sum(df$p.value < 0.05)}"))
    print(str_glue("Nr of significant differences (FDR) with FDR < 0.1 is {sum(df$padj < 0.1)}"))
    return(df)
  }
}

proliferation <- check_difference_from_mock(proliferation, verbose = TRUE)
proliferation |>
  arrange(padj) |>
  head()

migration <- check_difference_from_mock(migration, verbose = TRUE)
migration |>
  arrange(padj) |>
  head()

proliferation_SRB <- check_difference_from_mock(proliferation_SRB, verbose = TRUE)
proliferation_SRB |>
  arrange(padj) |>
  head()
```

### Select hits

```{r}
candidates <- inner_join(
  proliferation |>
    select(target, is_control, mean_prol, padj) |>
    mutate(
      proliferation_candidate = mean_prol < 0.8 & padj < 0.1,
      proliferation_50p_reduction = mean_prol < 0.50 & padj < 0.1
    ),
  migration |>
    select(target, mean_migration, padj) |>
    mutate(migration_candidate = mean_migration < migration_mock * 0.8 & padj < 0.1),
  by = "target", suffix = c("_prol", "_migration")
) |>
  inner_join(
    proliferation_SRB |>
      select(target, mean_proliferation_SRB, padj) |>
      mutate(
        proliferation_SRB_candidate = mean_proliferation_SRB < 80 & padj < 0.1,
        proliferation_SRB_50p_reduction = mean_proliferation_SRB < 50 & padj < 0.1
      ) |>
      rename(padj_proliferation_SRB = padj),
    by = "target"
  )

candidates |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = mean_prol, y = mean_proliferation_SRB,
    color = str_c(proliferation_candidate, proliferation_SRB_candidate)
  )) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 100, intercept = 0)

cor(candidates$mean_prol, candidates$mean_proliferation_SRB, method = "spearman")
candidates |>
  filter(
    proliferation_candidate &
      migration_candidate &
      proliferation_SRB_candidate
  )
```

Count the number of proliferation-reducing targets:

```{r}
candidates |>
  filter(is_control == "candidate") |>
  select(proliferation_candidate, proliferation_SRB_candidate) |>
  table()

candidates |>
  filter(is_control == "candidate") |>
  select(proliferation_50p_reduction, proliferation_SRB_50p_reduction) |>
  table()
```

Count the number of migration-reducing targets:

```{r}
  pull(migration_candidate) |>
  table()
```

```{r}
candidates |>

  table()
```

```{r}
candidates |>
  filter(is_control == "candidate") |>
  select(
    proliferation_50p_reduction,
    proliferation_SRB_50p_reduction,
    migration_candidate
  ) |>

```

Only migration, no proliferation

```{r}
candidates |>
  filter(
    migration_candidate &
      !proliferation_candidate &
      !proliferation_SRB_candidate
  )

candidates |>
  filter(
    migration_candidate &
      !proliferation_50p_reduction &
      !proliferation_SRB_50p_reduction
  )
```

Migration and proliferation

```{r}
candidates |>
  filter(
    migration_candidate &
      proliferation_50p_reduction &
      proliferation_SRB_50p_reduction
  )
```

